series_name: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord
title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord
synopsis: This college kid wants nothing more than a quiet life. So when she's reborn as Yumiella, the hidden villainess of an Otome RPG, she's not exactly thrilled. Still yearning for peace, she abandons her evil duties to live a more discreet life. Until her gamer side kicks in, and she accidentally reaches level 99! Now, everyone suspects that she's the infamous Demon Lord. What future awaits her?
